description: This file contains Redux action creators and related logic for managing channel sidebar categories, channel selection, and drag-and-drop operations in the Mattermost web application.

methods.name: setUnreadFilterEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the unread filter in the channel sidebar.

methods.name: setDraggingState
methods.description: Sets the dragging state for channel reordering.

methods.name: stopDragging
methods.description: Stops the drag operation in the channel sidebar.

methods.name: createCategory
methods.description: Creates a new channel category for a team, optionally selecting multiple channels.

methods.name: addChannelsInSidebar
methods.description: Adds a channel to a category at the first position in the sidebar.

methods.name: moveChannelsInSidebar
methods.description: Moves one or multiple channels to a specified category and position, accounting for archived channels.

methods.name: adjustTargetIndexForMove
methods.description: Calculates the correct target index for moving channels, considering archived channels and current category state.

methods.name: clearChannelSelection
methods.description: Clears multi-channel selection in the sidebar.

methods.name: multiSelectChannelAdd
methods.description: Adds a channel to the current multi-selection.

methods.name: multiSelectChannelTo
methods.description: Selects a range of channels between the last selected and the current channel for multi-selection.
